correctness.rationale: Normalized spherical orthant gamma moments are integrated exactly; the nine-dimensional lowpass polynomial space decomposes as 3 trivial plus 3 standard copies of S3. Two explicit three-by-three Hermitian generalized Gram matrices yield all eigenvalues and correct double multiplicities. A standalone SymPy checker independently reconstructs the full nine-by-nine moment matrices, verifies both blocks and the Shannon trace, then uses Machin-series rational bounds for pi to certify three simple roots in each disjoint bracket and identify unique symmetric extrema. Analytic representation decomposition, not finite enumeration, proves completeness. Numerical values are illustrative only.

The complete lowpass degree-2 spectral classification determines exact stability of recovering all nine coupled harmonic modes, including a very small simple leakage eigenvalue and sharp singular condition number near 362.611.
